boundaries: MERA is the player/GM engineering, refit, rebuild and assembly orchestration layer; it does not become a second Item/Asset, crafting, salvage, vehicle, Profession, Project, economy or rules ledger
LSS retains recoverable-object, decomposition, partial stripping, salvage, scavenging, donor-component, cannibalization-lineage and salvage-provenance authority
PPIA-03/D17 retain Item/Asset identity, ownership, custody, location, containment, condition, durability, installation/modification and history authority
MIB-12 retains crafting, repair, refurbishment and transformation transaction authority and conservation-safe input/output receipts
MIB-13 retains price, market, trade and service-economy truth
MIB-14/PPIA-04/F014 retain vehicle, platform, base, mecha, spacecraft/starship definition, compatibility-foundation and operational authority
APW/D26 retains durable Project/task, participants, prerequisites, campaign-time and cancellation authority
DPL/Profession owners retain Character work capability, engineering/mechanic skill, learning and profession/life-simulation truth
MRCS retains reusable component, interface, engineering-profile, compatibility-rule, work-recipe and blueprint-definition authoring authority

GPR retains the reusable gameplay-pattern execution/composition substrate; MERA may express engineering interactions through GPR operations/patterns but remains the engineering owner and may not redefine GPR core semantics ad hoc
ARI retains imported/generated media/resource identity, rights and provenance rather than mechanical component truth
MBES consumes accepted MERA engineering capabilities for machinery, utilities, infrastructure, workshops, garages and shipyards without creating a second engineering engine
engineering-resolution levels remain distinct and may stop at the highest source-supported detail: Asset → system → assembly → subassembly → component → interface/connection → governed network
unknown or source-unspecified lower-level topology, capacity, compatibility, failure mode, network, hazard or operating envelope remains unresolved rather than fabricated
a blueprint, proposed configuration, dry-run or simulation is non-authoritative until owner-domain operations commit
diagnostic surfaces distinguish observed symptoms, suspicions, isolated faults, identified faults, hidden truth and unresolved cause rather than granting repair-screen omniscience
safe-disassembly prerequisites and ordering exist only where owner definitions specify hazards, dependencies or access requirements; MERA does not invent real-world engineering/safety rules
repair classes, wear, reliability, service intervals, calibration, tuning, redundancy, cascading failure and graceful degradation are profile-driven and have no universal MERA formula
jury-rigs, substitutes, adapters, bypasses and temporary replacements are evaluated from governed definitions and may not receive invented generic penalties or bonuses
damage may affect salvageability/recoverability only through explicit owner-defined profiles while LSS remains the decomposition and output authority
no 3D renderer, physics sandbox or precision spatial manipulation is required for blocking engineering workflows; schematic/nonvisual operation has functional parity
optional AI is visibility-safe advisory only and cannot install, uninstall, dismantle, consume, fabricate, repair, spend, transfer, configure, approve hazards or declare an Asset operational
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking engineering, planning, diagnostic, refit, test or validation workflows
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected code, data, formulas, authored content, UI expression, assets, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no implementation authority until separately governed start
